title: Membership activation
bodyMd:
Every membership issued during the quarter has the same 30-day observation period. Activation means the member made at least one visit.

| Category | Issued memberships | Activated memberships |
|---|---:|---:|
| Basic | 100 | 55 |
| Plus | 200 | 140 |
| Team | 300 | 225 |
